title: Mix Pack
descriptionHtml:
¡Descubre el Mix Pack de Floopp Bites y deja que tu perro pruebe todos nuestros sabores mientras tú ahorras!   • 🌙 Sweet Dreams Cookie (95 g)

Cada receta está elaborada con ingredientes 100 % naturales, cuidadosamente seleccionados para ofrecer un snack saludable para perros lleno de sabor y beneficios. Encontrarás opciones con carne y también recetas vegetales, todas preparadas sin conservantes ni colorantes artificiales y con ingredientes funcionales como frutas, verduras, semillas de lino, miel, levadura nutricional, yogur o cúrcuma, que ayudan a favorecer una digestión saludable, un pelaje brillante y el bienestar diario.

Este pack combina dos texturas para adaptarse a todos los gustos. Las Cookies son unas galletas para perros crujientes, perfectas como premio diario, mientras que los Chewy Bites ofrecen una textura tierna y semihúmeda, ideal para entrenamientos, paseos o simplemente para consentir a tu mejor amigo. Gracias a su tamaño, son adecuados para perros pequeños, medianos y grandes, así como para cachorros a partir de los 4 meses y perros adultos.

Este surtido es una excelente opción para perros con digestiones sensibles o tutores que buscan una alimentación más natural, ya que todos nuestros snacks están elaborados sin incluir ningún ingrediente artificial, todo el aroma y sabor proviene exclusivamente de los ingredientes naturales y sin modificar que usamos en nuestras recetas. Son los premios para perros perfectos para reforzar el aprendizaje, premiar un buen comportamiento o sorprender a tu perro con nuevos sabores.

Si buscas un pack de snacks para perros que reúna toda la variedad de Floopp Bites, este es el formato ideal. Ocho recetas diferentes, dos texturas, ingredientes naturales y 680 g de snacks premium para perros para que cada día sea una nueva experiencia llena de sabor.

title: "Buffalo" collar LIMITED

Made from 100% naturally tanned genuine leather, this collar is durable, stylish, and completely handmade. Inside, it features our Patented Orthopedic Soft Cushion for unmatched comfort and protection for your dog’s neck — ideal for both everyday wear and heavy-duty use.

Key Features

  • Orthopedic Soft Cushion — gentle on your dog’s neck, firm in structure
  • Handcrafted from naturally tanned leather

Perfect For

Ideal for large and giant breeds such as Cane Corso, Rottweiler, Presa Canario, American Bully, Bullmastiff, Doberman, Boxer, and Great Dane. The “Buffalo” Collar combines raw strength with the comfort and sophistication that defines Bestia craftsmanship.

Common Questions

    A: No — each collar has a naturally unique buffalo pattern, making every piece one of a kind.

    A: Yes. It’s designed for powerful breeds, with reinforced stitching and heavy-duty hardware.

Clean gently with a soft, dry cloth after use. Avoid soaking the collar in water. Use Bestia Leather Conditioner to keep the leather moisturized and prevent cracking. Keep hardware dry and store in a cool place away from direct sunlight.

Origin: Handmade in Europe

title: The "Maximus" collar 2.5 inch wide black & gold
descriptionHtml:
BESTIA COLLARS®
proudly presents:

MAXIMUS Collar — Black & Gold

The Maximus collar speaks for itself — stylish, impressive, and so comfortable. Built on a 4 mm thick base of high-quality belt leather for exceptional durability, it features a smooth inner cushion in premium lamb leather. Handcrafted in Europe with brass-plated (gold) hardware, Maximus delivers a refined, commanding look for strong dogs.

Key Measurements

Total width (with cushion): 2.5" (6.5 cm)
Hardware (buckle & D-ring): 5 cm (2")

Key Features

  • Soft padded for absolute comfort, featuring Bestia’s Patented Soft Cushion — an Orthopedic Foam core wrapped in genuine lamb leather
  • 4 mm thick high-quality belt leather base for strength and shape stability
  • Signature rivet layout: 5/6/7 large rivets + 18/21/24 small rivets for balanced presence
  • Brass-plated (gold) metal parts for a luxurious, warm finish
  • Heavy-duty 5 cm buckle and D-ring for secure control
  • Comfort-smooth inner feel to help minimise rubbing on long walks
  • Handmade in Europe with meticulous attention to fit and finish

Common Questions

  • Q: Is the lamb-leather cushion durable for daily wear?
    A: Yes — it’s wrapped over an orthopedic foam core for comfort and backed by a robust belt-leather base for longevity.
  • Q: Will the gold hardware tarnish?
    A: Brass-plated hardware naturally develops a light patina over time. Wipe dry after wet walks to preserve its golden tone.
  • Q: Is Maximus suitable for strong, athletic breeds?
    A: Absolutely — the width, hardware, and construction are designed for confident handling and support on powerful dogs.
  • Q: Is shipping free?
    A: Yes — shipping is free on EU orders over €100. Express 24/48 h delivery is available at checkout.
  • Q: Do you sell direct from the workshop?
    A: Yes — Bestia designs and handmakes every piece in our own leather workshop in Bulgaria and sells it to you direct, with no middleman in between.
  • Q: What if a stud or fitting ever comes loose?
    A: Every Bestia piece carries a 30-day warranty against manufacturing defects. After that we still help: our workshop makes every model, so spare studs, plates and fittings for your exact piece usually exist — send us a photo and your order number.

Care Instructions

Wipe clean with a soft, slightly damp cloth and allow to dry naturally. For leather parts, condition occasionally with our Bestia Leather Cleaner and Bestia Leather Conditioner to maintain softness and shine. Avoid harsh chemicals and prolonged soaking.

Details

Every Maximus collar is handcrafted in our European workshop using 100% genuine leather. We cut, edge, and assemble each piece by hand, set the brass-plated hardware, and inspect the finish so it feels smooth in the hand and comfortable on your dog. Only collars that meet our standards for fit, feel, and build quality carry the Bestia name.

Materials: 100% genuine leather; lamb-leather padded lining; brass-plated (gold) hardware

Origin: Handmade in Europe

Brand: Bestia Collars — European craftsmanship, made with passion and precision.

• 100% genuine leather • soft padded • handmade quality • made in Europe • unique design
